title: Honey Flower: a Fairy Tale
author: Astrea
source: “Sydney Mail”  Geelong Advertiser p 6 https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/article/150378692?searchTerm=astrea%20fairy%20tale The Sydney Mail and New South Wales Advertiser  30 Oct 1897 p 929 https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/article/163797755?searchTerm=astrea%20fairy%20tale
comments: Girl called Wilga rescues a possum (“opossum”) at midnight. Possum transformed into girl called Honey Flower.  Wicked black witch woman captured and enchanted her as punishment for Honey Flower’s father killing her husband.  Disenchanted by dryad.
subject: Australian settings; Australian characters

title: An Australian Fairy Tale.  Yambournine, or The Enchanted Horse.
author: Astrea
source:
Leader (Melbourne) 8 Oct 1898 p 41. https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/article/197540639?searchTerm=fairy%20tale%20australian
Part II 15 Oct 1898. https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/article/197536123?searchTerm=astrea%20fairy%20tale
comments: An Anglo Australian girl has been brought up in an Aboriginal tribe, flees the violent warrior she is to marry, frees horses in stockyard.  Talking horse takes her away.  She disenchants him by riding through flames with him.
